description: Spec discovery asks whether the work should exist and what inaction costs, and settles the data model first (course decision 2026-11-02).
Stages process one issue or feature per invocation/tick.
Build/review claim-race checks re-read and back off without side effects.
Build/review stale claim recovery uses the SWEPT marker.
Build produces In Review and never marks work Done.
Review independently verifies by execution and reproduction.
Build/review report formats include an Agent identity line.
Build reports unreachable-repo skips through NO-SILENT-SKIP; review remains silent.
Review's passing verdicts set Approved; only integrate sets Done.

Integrate merges only after a valid human approval newer than the latest MERGE PROOF PACK, with a staleness guard. The only approval is Jonathan's Discord rocket judged APPROVED by deploy/discord_approval.py (DISCORD-APPROVAL-ONLY), bound to the exact head (APPROVAL-BOUND-TO-SHA); typed comments never count; any reader failure fails closed (WD-546). AGENTS.md carries the same markers.

description: Integrate processes one issue per invocation, backs off on races, skips unreachable repos silently, and reports agent identity.
Build cross-checks every numbered acceptance criterion against every numbered non-goal before editing.
Build and factory onboarding reject side-channel instructions outside the Linear issue.
Workers are forbidden from adding reactions to factory notification messages (read-only on reactions), mirroring the Linear bot-identity rule.
Build reserves BLOCKED comments for genuine spec defects.
Every review surface documents the five-tag, exactly-one-tag finding taxonomy.
Build and review skip parked NEEDS HUMAN work; build adds deduplicated skip diagnostics only.

Every build and review pickup surface carries DECISION-RECORD-UNPARK directly after PARKED-NEEDS-HUMAN-SKIP and states the one park-clearing test: Jonathan's assignment is removed AND a comment newer than the NEEDS HUMAN report is either a DECISION RECORD for that issue with a Discord message link or a comment Jonathan wrote himself in Linear. Build must carry the identical test to review, or a recorded decision can un-park review while build skips the issue forever.
Every build and review surface states, under DECISION-RECORD-UNPARK, that Jonathan is never asked to comment in Linear: he answers in Discord and Logan records it.

Every build and review surface states, under DECISION-RECORD-UNPARK, that a relayed decision without the Discord message link does NOT clear the park. Replaces unpark-requires-jonathan-authorship: the earlier rule required Jonathan's own Linear comment, which he no longer writes.
Every build and review surface states, under DECISION-RECORD-UNPARK, that workers never write a DECISION RECORD: Logan is the only recorder, so a build or review worker cannot un-park its own queue.
Every build surface selects FAIL rework before fresh Todo work while preserving priority and age inside each tier.
Every build surface creates or reuses one non-draft PR after branch publication and records it separately.
Every review surface enumerates present PR checks, waits without verdict on pending/outage, and tags failed jobs CI.
Every review surface states that all present checks govern the verdict and advisory red checks block PASS.
